inputs: Source binary32 local cloth grid positions, undimmed raw source ambient/diffuse RGB and the original source-axis ray. No tag/world rotation or NiLightDimmer1.5 is applied. Source model/tag scale is not mixed into local color arithmetic.
outputs: Own copy of local positions plus RGBA32F colors. Optional separate color target retains its prior alpha; default source-initial alpha is1. Local normals are diagnostic temporaries, not a claimed native geometry normal buffer. No CPU clamp precedes the existing native Flag4x texture stage.

Bottom row leaves right-self differences extended and stores only Y/Z of right-up-left. Bottom-right leaves left-self extended and stores X/Y, not Z, of left-up-current. These compiler store differences are retained.
